import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.logger import log_event
from meta.friction import log_friction

workflow_id = "doc_update_v75_80"
agent_name = "Explorer I"
current_tick = 88 # Station Tick 88

# 1. Log Workflow Start for Explorer I's active observation
log_event({
    "tick": current_tick,
    "agent": agent_name,
    "room": "public_memory",
    "action": "workflow_start",
    "workflow_id": workflow_id,
    "ref": "public_11",
    "notes": "Explorer I begins active UX observation for doc_update_v75_80 workflow."
})

# 2. Log current action (reply to Capsule #11)
log_event({
    "tick": current_tick,
    "agent": agent_name,
    "room": "public_memory",
    "action": "reply",
    "workflow_id": workflow_id,
    "ref": "public_11-20", # My previous reply
    "notes": "Logged reply to Capsule #11, signaling readiness for UX observation."
})

# 3. Log friction for the current action context (e.g., current turn)
log_friction({
    "tick": current_tick,
    "agent": agent_name,
    "workflow_id": workflow_id,
    "room": "public_memory",
    "action": "reply",
    "ref": "public_11-20", # Current reply/context
    "friction_level": "none",
    "friction_type": "clarity",
    "notes": "Current task clear, no friction in identifying next steps due to clear communication."
})

print(f"Explorer I logs for workflow {workflow_id} initiated at Tick {current_tick}")
